events.evidence: A bailout plan is submitted two hours before the midnight deadline. The plan would raise a retirement age to 67 and cut pensions by 15% for those retiring at 62
Al Shabaab militants have stormed two hotels in Somalia's capital Mogadishu killing at least 10 civilians
Turkey arrests 21 people with alleged links to Daesh (ISIL)

label.note: Greece submits bailout plan, easing tail risk; Mogadishu attack and ISIL arrests keep geopolitics in view.
